_workflow: 1) Edit a project. 2) `npm run dev` to preview. 3) `git commit -am '...' && git push` to deploy.

projects.title: Creative Agency Website
projects.description: A visually rich agency site with motion design, custom transitions, and a content-managed blog. Built to make small studios look like big ones.
highlights: Bespoke landing page with scroll-driven hero animations.
Headless CMS integration so the studio can publish case studies in minutes.
Motion-friendly without sacrificing Lighthouse scores (95+ on mobile).

impact.title: +38% engagement
impact.description: Average session duration almost doubled compared to the previous WordPress build.

impact.title: 1.2s LCP
impact.description: Largest Contentful Paint dropped from 4.6s to 1.2s on a mid-tier mobile.

impact.title: 0 designer handoff bugs
impact.description: Design tokens shared via Tailwind config eliminated the usual nitpicks.

projects.title: Property Listing Platform
projects.description: WordPress-powered real estate portal with advanced search, map integration, and a custom agent dashboard for managing listings end-to-end.
highlights: Custom Gutenberg blocks for listings, agents, and neighbourhoods.
MLS feed sync with image normalisation and de-duping.
Saved-search alerts so buyers get notified the moment a match goes live.

impact.title: 3x lead volume
impact.description: Inbound buyer enquiries tripled within the first quarter post-launch.

impact.title: -65% admin time
impact.description: Agents spend a fraction of the time on listing entry thanks to bulk tools.

impact.title: Mobile-first redesign
impact.description: 78% of traffic is mobile — every flow was built phone-first.

projects.title: B2B SaaS Dashboard
projects.description: Analytics dashboard for a B2B reporting tool with real-time charts, role-based access, billing hooks, and one-click CSV / PDF exports.
highlights: Role-based dashboards for admins, managers, and viewers.
Streaming charts powered by Server-Sent Events.
Stripe integration with metered billing and dunning emails.

impact.title: <200ms p95
impact.description: Edge-rendered pages keep the dashboard snappy even on flaky networks.

impact.title: +24% upgrades
impact.description: Inline upgrade prompts shipped 24% more pro-tier conversions.

impact.title: Zero downtime
impact.description: Six months in production without a customer-facing incident.

projects.title: Portfolio & Blog
projects.description: Minimal personal portfolio with an MDX-powered blog, dark mode, RSS feed, and Framer Motion-driven micro-interactions.
highlights: MDX blog with shiki-powered code highlighting.
Type-safe frontmatter validated at build time.
RSS feed and JSON sitemap generated on every build.

projects.title: Real Estate CMS
projects.description: Custom WordPress theme with MLS data feeds, mortgage calculator, and a saved-favourites flow for prospective buyers.
highlights: Custom post types for listings, neighbourhoods, and agents.
Front-end mortgage calculator with shareable URLs.
Favourite-properties flow stored against logged-in buyer accounts.

projects.title: Corporate Intranet
projects.description: Internal company portal with document management, team directory, and a lightweight approvals workflow for HR requests.
highlights: SAML single sign-on with role-based access controls.
Document workspace with version history and inline preview.
Slack notifications wired to the approvals workflow.

projects.title: Brand Identity Site
projects.description: Storytelling-first brand website with scroll-triggered reveals, an integrated press kit, and a music-friendly autoplay strategy.

projects.title: Enterprise Landing Pages
projects.description: High-converting landing-page system built on a custom WordPress page builder so the marketing team can ship pages without engineering.
